evidence: Modifies SOCKS5 proxy connection handling in src/netbase.cpp, directly altering Tor and proxy transport connectivity in P2P.
rationale: Fixes connection failures through SOCKS5 proxies using Tor for IPv6 addresses with an inner "::", restoring connectivity to 20%–50% of IPv6 peers. Without this fix, Tor exit relays misparse compressed IPv6 destinations and fail closed with "general failure" and no fallback, dropping roughly 20% of IPv6 addrman entries and 29% of DNS seed answers.
